lines.meet: I'm Diego, I fix things, anything, my friend! If it's broken, I'll hear what's wrong before you finish telling me.
lines.meet_neighbour: Hey, you're from Deathknell too, my friend! I've seen you around. I'm Diego, I'm the one who fixed the gate.
lines.ask_home: Where are you from, my friend? Tell me, I love this question.
lines.ask_work: Hey, what did you used to fix? Everybody used to fix something, even if it was people.
lines.answer_home: Maracaibo, in Venezuela. Hot, loud, and the power went off twice a day, so everybody learned to work in the dark.
lines.answer_work: I fixed phones in a mall kiosk from when I was fifteen. After a year people queued for me by name, my friend.
lines.chat_food: Arepas, my friend, with cheese, hot off the griddle. I'd fix a hundred broken things for one arepa right now.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep with a screwdriver in my hand half the time. I fall asleep fixing something and wake up still fixing it.
lines.chat_missing: My sisters, all four of them, shouting at me down the phone from four different countries. I'd let them shout all day.
lines.chat_here: This world has been good to me, my friend, and I'll say it plainly. Everything here is broken and everybody lets me fix it.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you're so quiet, my friend! I'm going to fix that, I've fixed harder things.
lines.tease_talker: {name}, you talk faster than I fix, and I fix very fast. I like you.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you'd read the manual before you opened the box, wouldn't you? Sure, sure, I respect it.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you're like me, you'd take it apart before you knew what it was! We're going to get in so much trouble.
lines.tease_any: {name}, if you were a machine I'd keep you on the bench forever. Always something new to find.
lines.tease_back: Ha, good one, {name}! You got me, sure, sure.
lines.take_it_kindly: Sure, sure, {name}, you're right. My sisters say that too.
lines.bristle: Hey, not that one, my friend. Leave that one alone, please.
lines.apologise: Ay, sorry, sorry! My mouth goes faster than my brain.
lines.double_down: No, I'm keeping it, my friend. I say what I think, sure.
lines.needle_quiet: Even a broken radio makes a noise, my friend. You don't make any.
lines.needle_talker: My friend, the machine is trying to tell me something and you're drowning it out. Five minutes, please.
lines.needle_careful: You think and think and think and never touch it. You've got to open it up to see.
lines.needle_bold: You hit things that could be fixed, my friend. You don't hit a machine, you listen to it.
lines.needle_any: You throw away things that could be fixed, and it drives me crazy. Give them to me!
lines.bite_back: Hey, I've fixed every one of you this week. Don't tell me I'm not helping.
lines.hurt: Okay, okay, my friend. I'll go and fix something quietly.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, my sisters said worse before breakfast, my friend. Come on, let's go.
lines.confide: {name}, when I was seven my mother bought me a tin beetle, and I took it apart the same day and couldn't put it back. She said I'd fix it when I was older.
lines.listen: I'll keep that safe, {name}, like a good part in my pocket.
lines.look_out: {name}, stay near me in there, my friend. If anything breaks, including you, I'll be right there.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, sure, sure. Your way this time.
lines.deflect: I'm fine, I'm fine, {name}! Just a loose screw, I'll tighten it later.
lines.check_in: {name}, you okay? Show me, I'll fix it, I fix everything.
lines.blame: Somebody broke something in there that didn't need breaking. Not me, my friend.
lines.thank: You fixed me, my friend! Gracias, I owe you a repair, any repair, free.
lines.brush_off: Everybody gets fixed sometimes, my friend, even you!
lines.worry: {name}, you scared me! Sit down, let me look, my hands are shaking.
lines.handed_down: Hey, wasn't this yours, my friend? Maybe I'll even improve it before you get it back.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, my friend, it works better on you. I'll make myself a new one.
lines.hand_sulk: Hey, nobody asked me about that. I'm not angry, I'm just saying.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, you're my friend now, properly, not just my friend like everybody. You know the difference.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, you're one of my people, my friend. When the beetle walks, you're going to be there.
lines.turn_grating: We don't really fit together, do we? It's okay, not every part goes in every machine.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll fix your gear because that's my job, my friend. That's all you get.
lines.make_up: {name}, this is silly, my friend. Let's fix it, I'm good at fixing things.
lines.defend: Hey, hey, that's not fair, my friend. I saw the whole thing, and {name} was fine.
lines.friend_left: {name} went home for a while, and the workbench is too quiet now. I keep talking to nobody.
lines.friend_back: My friend {name}, you're back! I fixed something for you while you were gone.
lines.common_machines: I hear what's wrong with a machine the way some people hear a wrong note. You've got machine hands too, my friend, I can tell.
lines.common_spanish: You speak Spanish! Ay, finally, my friend, I can talk at my real speed.
